title: What If Humans Lived to 200? (Short)

portraits.maya: Photorealistic head-and-shoulders portrait of a woman about 40 years old, shoulder-length wavy dark-brown hair, hazel eyes, light olive skin, a small beauty mark on her left cheek, warm natural smile, plain soft grey background, soft window light, sharp focus, 85mm lens.

looks.maya: Maya: shoulder-length wavy dark-brown hair, hazel eyes, light olive skin, a small beauty mark on her left cheek, same face as the reference portrait

style: Cinematic photorealistic film still, vertical 9:16 composition with the subject centered, shallow depth of field, natural warm color grade, near-future setting, no text other than what is described.

scenes.image: Extreme close-up of Maya at her 100th birthday party, she looks only about 40, glowing candlelight on her face, a cake with gold number candles 1-0-0 in the foreground, friends blurred behind.
lines: [intrigued, leaning in] What if turning a hundred...
sfx: Party poppers and a small crowd cheering at a birthday

scenes.image: Maya laughing and blowing out the 1-0-0 candles, confetti in the air, warm party lights.
lines: meant you were only... halfway there?

scenes.image: Maya at about 25 years old in a graduation cap and gown, throwing her cap in the air on a sunny campus.
Maya, now 80 but looking about 38, in a flight-school cockpit wearing a headset, starting a brand new career as a pilot, determined smile.
Maya, 120 but looking about 42, in an elegant wedding dress dancing with her new husband under string lights, joyful.
lines: [warmly] Fall in love again... at one hundred and twenty.

scenes.image: Maya at a cluttered office desk late at night, a coworker hands her a cake labeled 'Happy 100 Years at the Company', she stares at it in disbelief.
lines: [amused] But retire at sixty-five? Forget it.

scenes.image: A packed futuristic subway car at rush hour, crowded with ageless-looking commuters in work clothes, Maya squeezed among them holding a coffee.
lines: Try working for a hundred and thirty years.

scenes.image: A young couple in their late twenties standing on a sidewalk staring longingly at a charming suburban dream house with a 'NOT FOR SALE' sign in the yard.
On the porch of the same charming house, a cheerful couple who look about 60 but are 170 years old, waving and holding iced tea.
lines: Your great-grandparents still live in it.
sfx: A short burst of a small audience laughing

scenes.image: A huge family dinner table in a warm dining room, five generations who all look between 5 and 60 years old, Maya at the head of the table, now looking about 60 with silver streaks in her hair.
lines: [warm] Five generations... at one dinner table.
sfx: Clinking glasses and cheerful family chatter at a dinner table

scenes.image: Maya, looking about 60 with silver streaks, wagging a finger at a sheepish 30-year-old man across the dinner table while everyone laughs.
lines: [laughing] Your great-great-grandma... still telling you what to do.

scenes.image: Maya, now 200 but looking about 65 with silver hair, alone by a dark window at night, city lights reflected, thoughtful and quiet.
lines: [softer, thoughtful] So here's the real question.

scenes.image: Maya, silver-haired, sitting alone at a small kitchen table in a dim room in front of a cake with candles shaped 2-0-0, a single warm light, empty chairs around her.
lines: [quiet, sincere] Would you actually *want* to live to two hundred?
sfx: A soft low cinematic drone swelling then fading
